sql: SELECT team.team_name, city.area, player.position, manager.own_year FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE (player.mvp_awards <= 1 AND team.championship <= 1) OR (manager.nationality = 'Taiwanese-Canadian' AND player.mvp_awards < 0);
exclusion: gold answer is empty (scores 0 for any answer)
